name: ad-skipper
description: ad-skipper is an Android accessibility service that automatically skips splash-screen ads using a three-tier detection pipeline: node match first, OCR second, and finally llama.cpp GGUF VLM grounding for the hard cases. The combination of accessibility APIs with a local vision-language model is a genuinely novel stack, and it turns a daily annoyance into a solved problem — at least for the technically inclined.
highlights: Three-tier detection: node match → OCR → VLM grounding
Runs a local llama.cpp GGUF vision model on-device
curatorNote: Skipping splash ads is usually a fragile whack-a-mole of node matching. Adding OCR and a local VLM as fallback tiers is the first architecture that could actually keep up with new ad templates.
